title: AWS IAM (Identity & Access Management)
summary: Curriculum compiled from AWS IAM (Identity & Access Management). Services: IAM, S3, EC2, Lambda, CloudWatch, CloudTrail.

objectives.title: Explain how IAM users, groups, roles, and policies authorize S3 and Lambda calls.
Create IAM roles with least-privilege permissions for CloudWatch Logs.
Configure MFA on the root user and stop using root for daily work.

skipGate.prompt: Without repeating the beginner labs, explain a production-ready IAM control from this curriculum and name the AWS service it depends on.

objectives.title: Design a production IAM strategy for a multi-team organization.
